name: Antique Master
steps: Check the cracked gem, glued beads, and damaged chain. Tap Deal at $0.
Check the date 2099 and chocolate foil edge. Tap Deal at $0.
Check the scratches, rusty buckle, fake patch, and origin tag. Tap Deal at $0.
Check the fake signature and card pattern. Flip it and check the chipped paint.
Check the painting, then tap the rotary phone to call the police.
